030/**
031 * Provides utility functions to support reading and writing JSON, and for
032 * producing error and warning messages.
033 */
034public final class JsonUtil {
035  private static final Logger LOGGER = LogManager.getLogger(JsonUtil.class);
036
037  private JsonUtil() {
038    // disable construction
039  }
040
041  /**
042   * Parse the input stream into a JSON object.
043   *
044   * @param is
045   *          the input stream to parse
046   * @return the JSON object
047   */
048  @NonNull
049  public static JSONObject toJsonObject(@NonNull InputStream is) {
050    return new JSONObject(new JSONTokener(is));
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Parse the reader into a JSON object.
055   *
056   * @param reader
057   *          the reader to parse
058   * @return the JSON object
059   */
060  @NonNull
061  public static JSONObject toJsonObject(@NonNull Reader reader) {
062    return new JSONObject(new JSONTokener(reader));
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Generate an informational string describing the token at the current location
067   * of the provided {@code parser}.
068   *
069   * @param parser
070   *          the JSON parser
071   * @param resource
072   *          the resource being parsed
073   * @return the informational string
074   * @throws IOException
075   *           if an error occurred while getting the information from the parser
076   */
077  @NonNull
078  public static String toString(
079      @NonNull JsonParser parser,
080      @NonNull URI resource) throws IOException {
081    return new StringBuilder(32)
082        .append(parser.currentToken().name())
083        .append(" '")
084        .append(parser.getText())
085        .append('\'')
086        .append(generateLocationMessage(parser, resource))
087        .toString();
088  }
089
090  /**
091   * Generate an informational string describing the provided {@code location}.
092   *
093   * @param location
094   *          a JSON parser location
095   * @return the informational string
096   */
097  @NonNull
098  public static String toString(@NonNull JsonLocation location) {
099    return new StringBuilder(8)
100        .append(location.getLineNr())
101        .append(':')
102        .append(location.getColumnNr())
103        .toString();
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Advance the parser to the next location matching the provided token.
108   *
109   * @param parser
110   *          the JSON parser
111   * @param resource
112   *          the resource being parsed
113   * @param token
114   *          the expected token
115   * @return the current token or {@code null} if no tokens remain in the stream
116   * @throws IOException
117   *           if an error occurred while parsing the JSON
118   */
119  @Nullable
120  public static JsonToken advanceTo(
121      @NonNull JsonParser parser,
122      @NonNull URI resource,
123      @NonNull JsonToken token) throws IOException {
124    JsonToken currentToken = null;
125    while (parser.hasCurrentToken() && (currentToken = parser.currentToken()) != token) {
126      currentToken = parser.nextToken();
127      if (LOGGER.isWarnEnabled()) {
128        LOGGER.warn("skipping over: {}",
129            toString(parser, resource));
130      }
131    }
132    return currentToken;
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * Skip the next JSON value in the stream.
137   *
138   * @param parser
139   *          the JSON parser
140   * @param resource
141   *          the resource being parsed
142   * @return the current token or {@code null} if no tokens remain in the stream
143   * @throws IOException
144   *           if an error occurred while parsing the JSON
145   */
146  @SuppressWarnings({
147      "resource", // parser not owned
148      "PMD.CyclomaticComplexity" // acceptable
149  })
150  @Nullable
151  public static JsonToken skipNextValue(
152      @NonNull JsonParser parser,
153      @NonNull URI resource) throws IOException {
154
155    JsonToken currentToken = parser.currentToken();
156    // skip the field name
157    if (currentToken == JsonToken.FIELD_NAME) {
158      currentToken = parser.nextToken();
159    }
160
161    switch (currentToken) {
162    case START_ARRAY:
163    case START_OBJECT:
164    case VALUE_EMBEDDED_OBJECT:
165      parser.skipChildren();
166      break;
167    case VALUE_FALSE:
168    case VALUE_NULL:
169    case VALUE_NUMBER_FLOAT:
170    case VALUE_NUMBER_INT:
171    case VALUE_STRING:
172    case VALUE_TRUE:
173      // do nothing
174      break;
175    case FIELD_NAME:
176    case END_OBJECT:
177    case END_ARRAY:
178    case NOT_AVAILABLE:
179      // error
180      String msg = String.format("Unhandled JsonToken %s.",
181          toString(parser, resource));
182      LOGGER.error(msg);
183      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(msg);
184    }
185
186    // advance past the value
187    return parser.nextToken();
188  }

218  /**
219   * Ensure that the current token is one of the provided tokens.
220   * <p>
221   * Note: This uses a Java assertion to support debugging in a whay that doesn't
222   * impact parser performance during production operation.
223   *
224   * @param parser
225   *          the JSON parser
226   * @param resource
227   *          the resource being parsed
228   * @param expectedTokens
229   *          the tokens for which one is expected to match against the current
230   *          token
231   */
232  public static void assertCurrent(
233      @NonNull JsonParser parser,
234      @NonNull URI resource,
235      @NonNull JsonToken... expectedTokens) {
236    JsonToken current = parser.currentToken();
237    assert Arrays.stream(expectedTokens)
238        .anyMatch(expected -> expected == current) : generateExpectedMessage(
239            parser,
240            resource,
241            expectedTokens,
242            parser.currentToken());
243  }

254  /**
255   * Ensure that the current token is the one expected and then advance the token
256   * stream.
257   *
258   * @param parser
259   *          the JSON parser
260   * @param resource
261   *          the resource being parsed
262   * @param expectedToken
263   *          the expected token
264   * @return the next token
265   * @throws IOException
266   *           if an error occurred while reading the token stream
267   */
268  @Nullable
269  public static JsonToken assertAndAdvance(
270      @NonNull JsonParser parser,
271      @NonNull URI resource,
272      @NonNull JsonToken expectedToken)
273      throws IOException {
274    JsonToken token = parser.currentToken();
275    assert token == expectedToken : generateExpectedMessage(
276        parser,
277        resource,
278        expectedToken,
279        token);
280    return parser.nextToken();
281  }
282
283  /**
284   * Advance the token stream, then ensure that the current token is the one
285   * expected.
286   *
287   * @param parser
288   *          the JSON parser
289   * @param resource
290   *          the resource being parsed
291   * @param expectedToken
292   *          the expected token
293   * @return the next token
294   * @throws IOException
295   *           if an error occurred while reading the token stream
296   */
297  @Nullable
298  public static JsonToken advanceAndAssert(
299      @NonNull JsonParser parser,
300      @NonNull URI resource,
301      @NonNull JsonToken expectedToken)
302      throws IOException {
303    JsonToken token = parser.nextToken();
304    assert token == expectedToken : generateExpectedMessage(
305        parser,
306        resource,
307        expectedToken,
308        token);
309    return token;
310  }
311
312  /**
313   * Generate a message intended for error reporting based on a presumed token.
314   *
315   * @param parser
316   *          the JSON parser
317   * @param resource
318   *          the resource being parsed
319   * @param expectedToken
320   *          the expected token
321   * @param actualToken
322   *          the actual token found
323   * @return the message string
324   */
325  @NonNull
326  private static String generateExpectedMessage(
327      @NonNull JsonParser parser,
328      @NonNull URI resource,
329      @NonNull JsonToken expectedToken,
330      JsonToken actualToken) {
331    return ObjectUtils.notNull(
332        String.format("Expected JsonToken '%s', but found JsonToken '%s'%s.",
333            expectedToken,
334            actualToken,
335            generateLocationMessage(parser, resource)));
336  }
337
338  /**
339   * Generate a message intended for error reporting based on a presumed set of
340   * tokens.
341   *
342   * @param parser
343   *          the JSON parser
344   * @param resource
345   *          the resource being parsed
346   * @param expectedTokens
347   *          the set of expected tokens, one of which was expected to match the
348   *          actual token
349   * @param actualToken
350   *          the actual token found
351   * @return the message string
352   */
353  @NonNull
354  private static String generateExpectedMessage(
355      @NonNull JsonParser parser,
356      @NonNull URI resource,
357      @NonNull JsonToken[] expectedTokens,
358      JsonToken actualToken) {
359    List<JsonToken> expectedTokensList = ObjectUtils.notNull(Arrays.asList(expectedTokens));
360    return generateExpectedMessage(parser, resource, expectedTokensList, actualToken);
361  }
362
363  /**
364   * Generate a message intended for error reporting based on a presumed set of
365   * tokens.
366   *
367   * @param parser
368   *          the JSON parser
369   * @param resource
370   *          the resource being parsed
371   * @param expectedTokens
372   *          the set of expected tokens, one of which was expected to match the
373   *          actual token
374   * @param actualToken
375   *          the actual token found
376   * @return the message string
377   */
378  @NonNull
379  private static String generateExpectedMessage(
380      @NonNull JsonParser parser,
381      @NonNull URI resource,
382      @NonNull Collection<JsonToken> expectedTokens,
383      JsonToken actualToken) {
384    return ObjectUtils.notNull(
385        String.format("Expected JsonToken(s) '%s', but found JsonToken '%s'%s.",
386            expectedTokens.stream().map(Enum::name).collect(CustomCollectors.joiningWithOxfordComma("or")),
387            actualToken,
388            generateLocationMessage(parser, resource)));
389  }
390
391  /**
392   * Generate a location string for the current location in the JSON token stream.
393   *
394   * @param parser
395   *          the JSON parser
396   * @param resource
397   *          the resource being parsed
398   * @return the location string
399   */
400  @NonNull
401  public static CharSequence generateLocationMessage(@NonNull JsonParser parser, @NonNull URI resource) {
402    JsonLocation location = parser.currentLocation();
403    return location == null
404        ? " in '" + resource.toString() + "'"
405        : generateLocationMessage(location, resource);
406  }
407
408  /**
409   * Generate a location string for the current location in the JSON token stream.
410   *
411   * @param location
412   *          a JSON token stream location
413   * @param resource
414   *          the resource being parsed
415   * @return the location string
416   */
417  @NonNull
418  public static CharSequence generateLocationMessage(@NonNull JsonLocation location, @NonNull URI resource) {
419    return new StringBuilder()
420        .append(" in '")
421        .append(resource.toString())
422        .append("' at '")
423        .append(location.getLineNr())
424        .append(':')
425        .append(location.getColumnNr())
426        .append('\'');
427  }
